title: CNK-FarmaStatR: a reproducible platform for pharmaceutical statistics in education and research
description: Research and education platform for pharmaceutical statistics: in vitro population bioequivalence (FDA PSG 020929) with simulation-based design selection, f2 and bootstrap f2, model-independent and Weibull multivariate statistical distance for dissolution profiles. Validated R cores run in the browser (webR). Not a system validated for GxP environments. Code: MIT; documents: CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-belgeler.md).
